title: Beyond the Dirac Delta: Mitigating Diversity Collapse in Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Versatile Image Generation
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for fine-tuning large-scale generative models, such as diffusion and flow models, to align with complex human preferences and user-specified tasks. A fundamental limitation remains \textit{the curse of diversity collapse}, where the objective formulation and optimization landscape inherently collapse the policy to a Dirac delta distribution. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{DRIFT} (\textbf{D}ive\textbf{R}sity-\textbf{I}ncentivized Reinforcement \textbf{F}ine-\textbf{T}uning for Versatile Image Generation), an innovative framework that systematically incentivizes output diversity throughout the on-policy fine-tuning process, reconciling strong task alignment with high generation diversity to enhance versatility essential for applications that demand diverse candidate generations. We approach the problem across three representative perspectives: i) \textbf{sampling} a reward-concentrated subset that filters out reward outliers to prevent premature collapse; ii) \textbf{prompting} with stochastic variations to expand the conditioning space, and iii) \textbf{optimization} of the intra-group diversity with a potential-based reward shaping mechanism. Experimental results show that DRIFT achieves superior Pareto dominance regarding task alignment and generation diversity, yielding a $ 9.08\%\!\sim\! 43.46\%$ increase in diversity at equivalent alignment levels and a $ 59.65\% \!\sim\! 65.86\%$ increase in alignment at equivalent levels of diversity.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2601.12401v2 全文整理；截至本次审阅，论文 PDF 中未提供可用的公开代码 URL。
analysis.ideaZh: DRIFT 从 sampling、prompting 与 optimization 三处同时抑制 image-generation RFT 的 diversity collapse：筛选 reward-concentrated samples、扰动 early-denoising prompt embedding，并以 potential-based intra-group diversity reward 更新 policy。
methodFlow: 每个 prompt on-policy 生成 2G candidates
Reward-concentrated sampling 选择局部一致的 G 个样本
Early denoising 注入 noise-conditioned prompt embedding
计算 intra-group output diversity potential
Primary/diversity rewards 分别标准化为 advantages
Clipped decoupled advantage 更新 diffusion policy
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 用户持续关注 Image Generation 的重要 training paradigm。DRIFT 讨论的不是单一 prompt 或 narrow application，而是 RFT 普遍存在的 mode collapse；其 sampling、conditioning 与 reward design 也可能迁移到 2D Design 和 3D Generation 的 candidate-generation workflow。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告 SDv1.5/PickScore 下 DRIFT 的 DreamSim diversity 与 normalized reward 为 0.5698/0.9187，而 GRPO 为 0.3804/0.5927（Table 1, p. 7）；四个 backbone-reward 组合均形成更有利的 reward-diversity frontier，但均为作者报告的 automatic metrics。
analysis.caveatZh: 没有 human preference 或 downstream design-coverage 验证；每个 prompt 先生成 2G samples，并额外计算 group diversity，但论文没有量化完整 wall-clock、显存与成本。理论 invariance 与 clipping、normalization 组合后的适用边界也需谨慎解读。
analysis.motivationZh: On-policy reward optimization 容易把生成分布推向少数高分 modes；只追求 alignment 会削弱需要多候选探索的实际生成流程。论文试图在不放弃 primary reward 的前提下保留可用 diversity。
analysis.methodZh: 训练时先为每个 prompt 生成两倍候选，并用邻域累计距离去除 reward outliers；早期 denoising 对 prompt embedding 加更强噪声以扩展 conditioning space。随后把 clean-image intra-group dissimilarity写成 trajectory-level potential reward，将 primary 与 diversity advantages 分别标准化后，以 clipped decoupled objective 联合更新 diffusion policy。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者在 Stable Diffusion v1.5 与 SD3.5-M、PickScore 与 HPSv2 两类 rewards 上，与 DDPO、GRPO、GRPO-KL、GARDO 等比较，并用 DreamSim、CLIP diversity、Generalized Recall、Vendi Score 与 normalized reward 构造 Pareto frontier。主结果和组件分析一致支持 diversity-alignment trade-off 改善，但没有更大模型、flow/video/3D generation 或人工评测。
analysis.insightZh: 最值得迁移的不是某个新的 backbone，而是把 diversity collapse 拆成三个可独立干预的训练环节，并以 Pareto frontier 而非单一 reward checkpoint 判断 RFT 是否真的保留了候选空间。
